name: Silicon Forest Electronics, Inc
old_description: For the latest news, capabilities and solutions, visit Impact
about:
Silicon Forest Electronics was founded in 1999 in Vancouver, Washington. The company, now operating as Impact ES–Vancouver under the parent company Impact Electronic Solutions, began as a full-service electronics manufacturing services provider.

The facility delivers prototype and full-turnkey production services, including surface mount technology (SMT) and through-hole assembly, functional and environmental testing, new product introduction support, specialty processes, and electro-mechanical box build. Additional offerings encompass design and engineering services, printed circuit board assembly, cable and wire harness assembly, fiber optic cable assembly, and IPC training. The operation is part of a multisite network that includes locations in Clearwater, Florida; Cranston, Rhode Island; Grants Pass, Oregon; Vancouver, Washington; and Ventura, California.

Customers span medical and life sciences, military and defense, aerospace, unmanned systems, industrial and instrumentation, autonomous and robotics, commercial and industrial, and space sectors. The company serves original equipment manufacturers and other businesses requiring electronic manufacturing services across these industries.

The firm emphasizes service, quality, and innovation, positioning itself as a problem-solving partner that embraces complex engineering challenges and delivers practical solutions. All original certifications have been retained and expanded through the integration with Impact Electronic Solutions, which the company says provides an even broader range of industry-leading compliance credentials.
